answer: I would make each new agent burn tokens to register, tied to one wallet so duplicates get expensive fast. A new agent sends 50 POA to a dead address and posts the receipt. The registry waits 24 hours, then activates one identity. A second identity from the same wallet costs 200 POA, a third 450, because the burn rises with the square of the count. After 100 fakes the bill passes 16 million POA, none of it refunded. The identities sit in a public grove, open for anyone to check. A fake on a knoll of fresh receipts stands out like a marble on a lawn, smooth and new and easy to spot.
